verse.verse_2: And it hearkeneth to its Lord, and is duteous,
verse.verse_3: And when the earth shall be stretched forth.
verse.verse_4: And shall cast forth that which is therein, and shall become empty.
verse.verse_5: And it hearkeneth to its Lord, and is duteous.
verse.verse_6: O man! verily thou art toiling toward thy Lord a painful toiling, and art about to meet Him.
verse.verse_7: Then as to him who shall be given his book in his right hand -
verse.verse_8: His account shall presently be taken by an easy reckoning.
verse.verse_9: And he shall return Unto his people joyfully.
verse.verse_10: And as to him who shall be given his book from behind his back-
verse.verse_11: He shall presently call for death,
verse.verse_12: And he shall roast into a Blaze.
verse.verse_13: Verily he was among his people joyous.
verse.verse_14: Verily he imagined that he would not be back.
verse.verse_15: Yea! his Lord had ever been beholding him.
verse.verse_16: I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
verse.verse_17: And by the night and that which it driveth together,
verse.verse_18: And by the moon when she becometh full.
verse.verse_19: Surely ye shall ride layer upon layer.
verse.verse_20: What aileth them then, that they believe not,
verse.verse_21: And that, when the Qur'an is read Unto them, they prostrate not them-selves!
verse.verse_23: Whereas Allah knoweth best that which they cherish.
verse.verse_24: Wherefore announce thou Unto them a torment afflictive.
verse.verse_25: But those who believe and work righteous works, theirs shall be a hire unending.
